purpose: After RWA candidates COST5-SPO+, issuance timing, vertical PCA, exact height correction, and source separation have been gated or refuted, perform a bounded evidence-first re-entry across terrain representation, local pretrained NWP feasibility, discontinuous-reward decision learning, and repository-native untested mechanisms. Select at most one next executable prerequisite audit; do not fit or score.

terrain_sx.source_bound: at most 10 primary/official source packages plus named local reports
terrain_sx.question: Can direction-dependent terrain exposure or shelter derived from one static DEM be computed by a frozen published formula without the unidentifiable KMAPP wind-at-height term, and is it nonduplicate here?

pretrained_nwp.source_bound: at most 10 official source packages plus named local reports
pretrained_nwp.question: Is any pre-2026-07-05 commercially licensed local pretrained forecast model operationally runnable in the unchanged project environment from basis-safe GFS forecast states, with fixed development coverage and no remote inference?

step_reward.source_bound: at most 12 primary papers or official software sources plus named local reports
step_reward.question: Find a genuinely nonduplicate estimator for the 6%/8% band reward after COST5, direct band-hit estimation, member selection and postprocessing closures; specify one falsifiable smallest test or close the axis.

repo_mechanism.source_bound: repository and named local reports only; no web
repo_mechanism.question: Audit existing artifacts/code for a chronology-reconstructible but untested information or representation axis, excluding policy remixing, future-fold selection, 2024, rejected ECMWF and quarantined N10.

root_promotion_rule: Only root may reclassify a claim as actionable, and only when primary/official source, local machine fact, exact applicability, chronology, commercial licence and nonduplication gates are all explicit. Agent [derived] is not execution authority.

selection_rule.tie_break: prefer a no-fit prerequisite audit; then smaller external acquisition; then lexicographic candidate id

forbidden_actions: competition test archive or test-period access
